authorization_source: Root explicit instruction before TEST open: safety guards must pass macro and every valid context; both registered contexts need n>=20; no posttruth scope selection; original thresholds unchanged; missing/nearzero denominator handled only by existing metric rules; no new epsilon.

fixed_context_fraction_interpretation.with_two_registered_contexts: Both original contexts must be valid and both fixed-contrast U20 context point differences nonnegative. No dropping an invalid or negative context.

finite_and_denominator_policy: Use existing frozen metric/NA rules. Both context metrics, macro point and paired CI endpoints must be finite. Any missing/nonfinite or nearzero-baseline case that cannot be evaluated under those existing rules is NOT_ESTABLISHED. Do not add epsilon, impute a denominator, replace a missing metric or change the metric formula.

distinct_U20_evidence_levels.supported_positive_increment: macro delta_U20>=0.005 AND paired95CI lower>0; nominal support conditional on fixed fits

Source_seen_unseen_subgroups: Descriptive only; no replacing the primary cohort, choosing a subgroup winner, changing its independent gene-cluster denominator, or selecting another primary method. Source32seen112unseen pretruth counts describe coverage, not efficacy.
scope_note: This is a new dated pretruth interpretation of already registered guard values, authorized by Root. It is not an executable evaluator gate, source of new tests or authorization to open TEST.
